[EN] There are more kidnapped villagers. We must save them.
[ES] Hay más aldeanos secuestrados. Debemos salvarlos.

[EN] Were you in there all this time?
[ES] ¿Estuviste allí dentro todo este tiempo?

[EN] I see...there's more people to be saved.
[ES] Ya veo... hay más gente que salvar.

[EN] There were a lot of people captured near the Larvae Hatchery.
[ES] Había mucha gente capturada cerca de Larvae Hatchery.

[EN] I'll head for the Larvae Hatchery.
[ES] Ié a Larvae Hatchery.
